summaries.zh: ego-browser (ego-lite Windows preview) agent tools for DeepSeek Harness: execute one JavaScript script per browser task in the ego-browser nodejs runtime (page / page.locator / browser / taskSpaces / fetch / cdp facades, console.log output channel), plus an API guide tool and a host status tool. Host-only cordis plugin, mounted via cordis.patch.yml + a profile node_modules link; no dsh source changes.
